{{Quote|Imp or Sith come, we'll drive 'em off like we did Black Sun!|Skeeto|<ref name="Legacy 24">[[Legacy (2006) 24|''Legacy'' (2006) 24]]</ref>}}
'''Skeeto Rawk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Legacy 23" /> and a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] who was the adopted<ref name="Insider 101">{{InsiderCite|101|Blaster}}</ref> son of [[Droo Rawk]] and [[Rawk|Nat Skywalker]], then going by the alias "Bantha" Rawk. Skeeto had an older sister, [[Ahnah Rawk]], and a brother, [[Micah (Cathar)|Micah]]. During the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], Skeeto and Annah rode together on a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] as they joined the rest of their family in [[Skirmish on Iego|defending]] their home, [[Rawk's Nest]], from [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] invaders. They were assisted by the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']], piloted by [[Cade Skywalker]], [[Jariah Syn]] and [[Deliah Blue]].<ref name="Legacy 23" />

Four [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later, Skeeto and the others enjoyed the swimming pool and played ball with Jariah Syn. The Rawk family later watched the holonews about the [[Massacre of New Coral City|Massacre on Mon Calamari]]. It was then that Cade revealed that he was a Skywalker.<ref name="Legacy 24" /> Afterward, the family moved to [[Kiffu/Legends|Kiffu]] without Nat Skywalker.<ref name="Legacy 34">[[Legacy (2006) 34|''Legacy'' (2006) 34]]</ref>
